title: schedule.outbound_requested v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the schedule module when a member's change to an event on a provider calendar must be made at the provider: the connectors module's outbound work. Ids, the kind of change and a blob reference only; the provider's ids, the etag and the text are in the calendar-change v1 blob. Before it acts, connectors asks the schedule module to confirm the request through the kernel's calendar-requests port: an event alone proves nobody asked. Workspace-scoped.

request.description: Unique per request; the connector records each once.

calendar.description: The calendar (an id of the schedule module).

event.description: The event (an id of the schedule module).

connection.description: The connection whose grant makes the change (an id of the connectors module).

body.description: The calendar-change v1 document, a blob of the workspace.
